nodes.label: Harness
nodes.rationale: Opinionated runtime packaging tools, skills, sandbox, memory, subagents, and context management for long-horizon agents.

nodes.label: Long-Horizon Agent
nodes.rationale: Agent that sustains coordination across planning, tool calls, file work, and artifact delivery.

nodes.label: Skill
nodes.rationale: Task-oriented capability package loaded on demand to specialize the general base agent.

nodes.label: Sandbox
nodes.rationale: Isolated execution environment for file and command-based agent work.

nodes.label: Subagent
nodes.rationale: Focused worker handling delegated subtasks with scoped context and parallelism.

nodes.label: Context Engineering
nodes.rationale: Controls what the agent sees, remembers, and ignores via summarization, scoped subagent context, and filesystem working memory.

nodes.label: Memory
nodes.rationale: Cross-session retention of preferences, project context, and durable facts.

nodes.label: Artifact
nodes.rationale: Concrete deliverable output such as reports, files, charts, or code changes.

nodes.label: DeerFlow Harness
nodes.rationale: Python SDK and reusable runtime foundation for building custom agent systems.

nodes.label: DeerFlow App
nodes.rationale: Best-practice Super Agent application and reference implementation built on the Harness.

nodes.label: Lead Agent
nodes.rationale: Central executor in every thread; reasons, calls tools, delegates subagents, and returns artifacts.

nodes.label: ThreadState
nodes.rationale: LangGraph state holding conversation history, todos, artifacts, and runtime metadata.

nodes.label: Middleware Chain
nodes.rationale: Wraps every LLM turn with cross-cutting capabilities like memory, summarization, and clarification.

nodes.label: Plan Mode
nodes.rationale: Activates TodoMiddleware for visible structured task lists on complex multi-step work.

nodes.label: Thinking Mode
nodes.rationale: Exposes model internal reasoning steps in the response stream when supported.

nodes.label: Custom Agents
nodes.rationale: Per-agent config for skills, tool groups, model, and instructions stored in agents/{name}/config.yaml.

nodes.label: MemoryMiddleware
nodes.rationale: Injects memory at turn start and queues background fact extraction after conversations.

nodes.label: Structured Fact Store
nodes.rationale: Categories include work context, personal context, top of mind, history, and discrete facts.

nodes.label: Global Memory
nodes.rationale: Default memory at {base_dir}/memory.json when no per-agent memory is active.

nodes.label: Per-Agent Memory
nodes.rationale: Isolated memory at {base_dir}/agents/{agent_name}/memory.json for custom agents.

nodes.label: SummarizationMiddleware
nodes.rationale: Compresses older messages when token, message, or fraction thresholds are exceeded.

nodes.label: ClarificationMiddleware
nodes.rationale: Always-last middleware intercepting clarification tool calls into user-facing requests.

nodes.label: LoopDetectionMiddleware
nodes.rationale: Breaks repetitive tool-call loops via hidden loop_warning HumanMessage interventions.

nodes.label: TitleMiddleware
nodes.rationale: Auto-generates thread titles from the first user-agent exchange.

nodes.label: TodoMiddleware
nodes.rationale: Maintains visible task lists via write_todos when plan mode is active.

nodes.label: LocalSandbox
nodes.rationale: Default host filesystem sandbox; bash disabled unless allow_host_bash is true.

nodes.label: AioSandboxProvider
nodes.rationale: Container-isolated sandbox via Docker or Apple Container with LRU replica eviction.

nodes.label: Sandbox Path Mappings
nodes.rationale: Maps skills/ to /mnt/skills and thread user-data to /mnt/user-data/.

nodes.label: SKILL.md
nodes.rationale: Authoritative skill definition parsed for metadata, instructions, and tool requirements.

nodes.label: load_skills
nodes.rationale: Hot-reloads skills from public/ and custom/ directories on every call.

nodes.label: extensions_config.json
nodes.rationale: Runtime skill and MCP enable/disable state separate from config.yaml.

nodes.label: task Tool
nodes.rationale: Lead Agent delegation mechanism spawning isolated subagent invocations.

nodes.label: general-purpose Subagent
nodes.rationale: Built-in subagent for multi-step reasoning, search, files, and artifacts; 15-min default timeout.

nodes.label: bash Subagent
nodes.rationale: Command-line execution subagent available when sandbox bash tool is enabled.

nodes.label: ACP Agents
nodes.rationale: External agents invoked via Agent Connect Protocol and invoke_acp_agent tool.

nodes.label: Built-in Tools
nodes.rationale: Core harness tools: task, present_files, view_image, clarification, setup_agent, update_agent, invoke_acp_agent, tool_search.

nodes.label: Tool Groups
nodes.rationale: Named tool sets restricting which tools a custom agent can access.

nodes.label: Tool Search
nodes.rationale: Deferred tool loading via tool_search to reduce context from large MCP tool sets.

nodes.label: initialize_mcp_tools
nodes.rationale: Startup routine connecting enabled MCP servers and caching tool schemas with mtime invalidation.

nodes.label: MCP OAuth Support
nodes.rationale: Transparent OAuth flow via get_initial_oauth_headers and build_oauth_tool_interceptor.

nodes.label: config.yaml
nodes.rationale: Primary configuration surface for models, sandbox, tools, memory, and subsystem behavior.

nodes.label: Custom Middleware
nodes.rationale: AgentMiddleware implementations injected before ClarificationMiddleware via custom_middlewares.

nodes.label: DeerFlowClient
nodes.rationale: Primary library integration point wrapping LangGraph runtime with astream and ainvoke APIs.

nodes.label: Middleware Over Inheritance
nodes.rationale: Behavior composed via small middleware plugins instead of subclassing the agent core.

nodes.label: Artifacts Panel
nodes.rationale: UI surface for agent output files with preview and download in the workspace.

nodes.label: SafetyFinishReasonMiddleware
nodes.rationale: Suppresses partial tool calls when provider safety termination signals are detected.

nodes.label: DeerFlow 2.0 M1
nodes.rationale: Release candidate milestone for DeerFlow 2.0.

nodes.label: DeerFlowClient
nodes.rationale: Primary programmatic entry point for embedding DeerFlow in Python applications via astream/ainvoke.

nodes.label: AioSandboxProvider
nodes.rationale: Recommended for multi-user production isolation instead of LocalSandboxProvider.

nodes.label: use Field (Pluggable Components)
nodes.rationale: Enables pluggable instantiation via package.module:ClassName without hardcoding class references.

nodes.label: Harness vs Framework
nodes.source_location: 为什么是 Harness，而非 Framework
nodes.rationale: Harness ships a ready-to-run runtime with pre-wired infrastructure; frameworks require assembly.

nodes.label: Middleware Chain Design
nodes.rationale: Behavior composed from small isolated plugins rather than subclassing the Agent.

nodes.label: On-Demand Skills
nodes.source_location: 技能提供专业化但不污染上下文

nodes.label: Context Engineering
nodes.source_location: 上下文工程让长时序任务可控
nodes.rationale: Summarization, sub-agent isolation, external work memory, and memory injection manage context pressure.
